content.text: {"abstained":false,"abstention_reason":"","answer":"Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY) is an accident insurance scheme [E01]. The outcomes that trigger its cover are: death or disability on account of an accident [E01]. Specifically, on death, the nominee receives Rs. 2 Lakhs [E01]. For disability, coverage includes total and irrecoverable loss of both eyes or loss of use of both hands or feet or loss of sight of one eye and loss of use of hand or foot (Rs. 2 Lakhs) [E01], and total and irrecoverable loss of sight of one eye or loss of use of one hand or foot (Rs. 1 Lakh) [E01].","cited_evidence_ids":["E01"],"claim_to_evidence":[{"claim":"PMSBY stands for Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana and is an accident insurance scheme","evidence_ids":["E01"]},{"claim":"The scheme covers accidental death and disability","evidence_ids":["E01"]},{"claim":"On death, the nominee receives Rs. 2 Lakhs","evidence_ids":["E01"]},{"claim":"For total and irrecoverable loss of both eyes or loss of use of both hands or feet or loss of sight of one eye and loss of use of hand or foot, subscriber gets Rs. 2 Lakhs","evidence_ids":["E01"]},{"claim":"For total and irrecoverable loss of sight of one eye or loss of use of one hand or foot, subscriber gets Rs. 1 Lakh","evidence_ids":["E01"]}]}
